records.jp: あっ。愛央……
records.en_original: Uh, hey, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Uh, hey, Ao.
records.en: Ah. Ao...

records.jp: だーっ、毎回タイミング悪くてほんとごめんっ！<CR>デート中、お邪魔しまし……
records.en_original: Agh, sorry! I'm always in the wrong place at the wrong time! I didn't mean to interrupt your date...
records.en_auxiliary: Agh, sorry! I'm always in the wrong place at the wrong time! I didn't mean to interrupt your date...
records.en: Agh, I'm really sorry my timing is always so bad!<CR>Sorry to interrupt your date...

records.jp: 待って、星崎さん。今日はナイスタイミングだから。<CR>ちょっと聞きたいことがあるの
records.en_original: Wait, Hoshizaki. This actually works out perfectly. We want to ask you something.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Hoshizaki. This actually works out perfectly. We want to ask you something.
records.en: Wait, Hoshizaki-san. Today, your timing is perfect.<CR>There's something we want to ask you.

records.jp: 愛央はさ、「恋人らしいこと」ってなんだと思う？
records.en_original: What do you think it means to be in a relationship?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think it means to be in a relationship?
records.en: Ao, what do you think 'something lovers would do' is?

records.jp: あたしも伶那も、恋人がいたことなんてないからさ。<CR>それらしい過ごし方が分かんなくて
records.en_original: Neither Rena nor I have ever been in one, so we don't exactly know what we should be doing.
records.en_auxiliary: Neither Rena nor I have ever been in one, so we don't exactly know what we should be doing.
records.en: Neither Rena nor I have ever had a lover,<CR>so we don't know how to spend time like lovers.

records.jp: どこかに出かけようにも、<CR>ここにはココロトープしかないしね
records.en_original: Even if we wanted to go out somewhere, there's nowhere to go but the Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if we wanted to go out somewhere, there's nowhere to go but the Heartscape.
records.en: Even if we wanted to go somewhere,<CR>there's only the Heartscape here.

records.jp: なるほど、そういうことか……。<CR>まぁ、私にも恋人いたことなんてないんだけど……
records.en_original: Huh, I see... Well, I've never been in a relationship either...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, I see... Well, I've never been in a relationship either...
records.en: I see, so that's what this is about...<CR>Well, I've never had a lover either...

records.jp: あは。やっぱり？
records.en_original: Haha. Yeah, thought so.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha. Yeah, thought so.
records.en: Ahaha. I thought so.

records.jp: ちょっと！<CR>人に聞いておきながらその返答はどうよ！？
records.en_original: Hey, that's mean! Do you want my advice or not?!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, that's mean! Do you want my advice or not?!
records.en: Hey!<CR>What kind of answer is that after asking me!?

records.jp: （でも……なんとか力になってあげたいな。<CR>雫世界でようやく結ばれた二人なんだし……）
records.en_original: (I would like to help in some way. Oasis allowed them to finally be together...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I would like to help in some way. Oasis allowed them to finally be together...)
records.en: (But... I want to help them somehow.<CR>They finally got together here in Oasis, after all...)

records.jp: ……恋人がいたことはないけど。大丈夫。任せて。<CR>推しで見たいシチュエーションだと思えば、余裕だし
records.en_original: I may not have ever been in a relationship, but you can count on me. I'll just think of what I'd write in a fanfic about you two!
records.en_auxiliary: I may not have ever been in a relationship, but you can count on me. I'll just think of what I'd write in a fanfic about you two!
records.en: ...I've never had a lover, but it's fine. Leave it to me.<CR>If I think of it as a situation I'd want to see with my oshi, it's easy.

records.jp: 恋人らしいこと……それはずばり！<CR>伶那さんが膝枕をしてあげればいいんだよ！
records.en_original: Hmm... Well, if you want to look like a couple, Rena should let you lay your head on her lap!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Well, if you want to look like a couple, Rena should let you lay your head on her lap!
records.en: Something lovers would do... namely!<CR>Rena-san should give Yuki a lap pillow!

records.jp: くっ……その、もの言いたげな視線……！<CR>でも私に聞いたからには、絶対やってもらうから！
records.en_original: Aah! Don't look at me like that! You came to me for advice, so you better take it seriously!
records.en_auxiliary: Aah! Don't look at me like that! You came to me for advice, so you better take it seriously!
records.en: Ghh... Those looks that say you have something to say...!<CR>But now that you asked me, I'm absolutely making you do it!

records.jp: ミッションコンプリートしたかどうか、<CR>あとで勇希に確認するからね！　さらば──
records.en_original: I'll check in with Yuki later to find out whether you did it or not! Bye then!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll check in with Yuki later to find out whether you did it or not! Bye then!
records.en: I'll ask Yuki later whether you completed the mission!<CR>Farewell—

records.jp: ストップ。一応、礼は言わせてよ。<CR>いつもなんだかんだ、私たちのこと心配してくれてるし
records.en_original: Stop. At least let me thank you. You've always been there for us.
records.en_auxiliary: Stop. At least let me thank you. You've always been there for us.
records.en: Stop. At least let me thank you.<CR>One way or another, you're always worrying about us.

records.jp: ……えっ。えー、いいよいいよ、お礼なんて！<CR>私のことは気にせず、勇希とのデート満喫して！　ね！
records.en_original: ...Huh? Aww, you don't have to thank me! Just go and enjoy your date!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh? Aww, you don't have to thank me! Just go and enjoy your date!
records.en: ...Huh? Oh, no, no, you don't need to thank me!<CR>Don't mind me—just enjoy your date with Yuki! Okay!

records.jp: 愛央、やっぱいい奴だよね。<CR>……で、膝枕、ほんとにしてくれるの？
records.en_original: What a nice person. So...will you let me lie on your lap or not?
records.en_auxiliary: What a nice person. So...will you let me lie on your lap or not?
records.en: Ao really is a good person.<CR>...So, will you really give me a lap pillow?

records.jp: や、やるわよ。ちゃんと。ほら、こっち来て
records.en_original: S-sure I will. All right, come here.
records.en_auxiliary: S-sure I will. All right, come here.
records.en: I-I will. Properly. Here, come over.

records.jp: …………おー。これは……
records.en_original: Huh... This is...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... This is...
records.en: ......Oh. This is...

records.jp: なによ
records.en_original: This is what?
records.en_auxiliary: This is what?
records.en: What?

records.jp: むにむにだね
records.en_original: Squishy.
records.en_auxiliary: Squishy.
records.en: It's soft and squishy.

records.jp: 肉付きがいいとでも言いたいわけ？
records.en_original: Are you saying I'm fat?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you saying I'm fat?
records.en: Are you trying to say I'm plump?

records.jp: そーんなこといってないじゃん？<CR>んふふ……このままお昼寝ってのもいいなー
records.en_original: Noooo, not at all! Hehe... I could take a nap just like this...
records.en_auxiliary: Noooo, not at all! Hehe... I could take a nap just like this...
records.en: I didn't say anything like thaaat, did I?<CR>Nfufu... Taking a nap like this might be nice too.

records.jp: 恋人らしいこと……それはずばり！<CR>勇希が手をつないであげればいいんだよ！
records.en_original: Hmm... Well, if you want to look like a couple, you and Rena should hold hands!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Well, if you want to look like a couple, you and Rena should hold hands!
records.en: Something lovers would do... namely!<CR>Yuki should hold Rena-san's hand!

records.jp: もちろん、普通に手をつなぐんじゃダメだからね？<CR>恋人っぽく！　勇希から伶那さんに甘える！
records.en_original: Of course, you can't just hold hands normally—you have to do it in a romantic way!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, you can't just hold hands normally—you have to do it in a romantic way!
records.en: Of course, you can't just hold hands normally, okay?<CR>Like lovers! Yuki has to act spoiled toward Rena-san!

records.jp: えっ……あ、甘えるって……
records.en_original: Wait, what? R-romantic...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, what? R-romantic...?
records.en: Huh... A-act spoiled...?

records.jp: ……んで、幸せをた～っぷり満喫すること。<CR>こっちが照れるくらいののろけ話、後で聞かせてよね
records.en_original: You have to feel the happiness course through you! Tell me all about it later! It better be so mushy that just hearing about it makes me blush!
records.en_auxiliary: You have to feel the happiness course through you! Tell me all about it later! It better be so mushy that just hearing about it makes me blush!
records.en: ...And savor pleeenty of happiness.<CR>Later, tell me a lovey-dovey story that makes even me blush.

records.jp: ……おせっかい。<CR>……ありがと
records.en_original: ...Thanks, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thanks, I guess.
records.en: ...Meddler.<CR>...Thanks.

records.jp: ……さて、どうするの？　勇希？
records.en_original: So, what are you going to do, Yuki?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what are you going to do, Yuki?
records.en: ...Now then, what will you do, Yuki?

records.jp: うっ……。……うーっ、待って待ってなんか恥ずい！<CR>手を繋ぐなんて珍しくないのに、改まると、なんか！
records.en_original: I...uh... W-wait, I'm getting nervous! I mean, we hold hands all the time, but I've never had to think about it like this!
records.en_auxiliary: I...uh... W-wait, I'm getting nervous! I mean, we hold hands all the time, but I've never had to think about it like this!
records.en: Ugh... W-wait, wait, this is somehow embarrassing!<CR>Holding hands isn't unusual, but when we make a thing of it, it just...!

records.jp: ……ふふっ
records.en_original: ...Hehe.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hehe.
records.en: ...Hehe.

records.jp: あ……手汗！　手汗かいてるかも、あたし！<CR>気持ち悪かったら離してね！　まじで！
records.en_original: M-my hands might be sweaty! Just let go if it's gross! Seriously!
records.en_auxiliary: M-my hands might be sweaty! Just let go if it's gross! Seriously!
records.en: Ah... sweaty hands! My hands might be sweaty!<CR>If it feels gross, let go, okay! Seriously!

records.jp: そんなこと、するわけないでしょ
records.en_original: I'm not going to do that.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not going to do that.
records.en: There's no way I'd do that.

records.jp: 伶那の手、綺麗だね。ちょっと憧れちゃう
records.en_original: You have such beautiful hands, Rena. I'm jealous.
records.en_auxiliary: You have such beautiful hands, Rena. I'm jealous.
records.en: Rena's hands are beautiful. I'm a little envious.

records.jp: あんたのものだから。好きなだけ見ていいよ
records.en_original: They're yours, Yuki. You can look at them all you want.
records.en_auxiliary: They're yours, Yuki. You can look at them all you want.
records.en: They're yours. You can look as much as you want.

records.jp: ぅ……。あの……。えっと………は、はい……
records.en_original: Uh... Um... O-okay...
records.en_auxiliary: Uh... Um... O-okay...
records.en: Uh... Um... Er... Y-yes...
